purpose: Controlled correctness checks complementary to retrieval and agent quality; not additional scored relevance questions
fixturePolicy: Fresh disposable fixture only. Never mutate the working checkout. Capture complete compiler contexts before publication. Use the same pinned model and index manifest before and after each change.

initialFiles.library/src/policy.ts: export function canReadDocument(ownerId: string, actorId: string): boolean { return ownerId === actorId; }
initialFiles.client/src/read.ts:
import { canReadDocument } from '../../library/src/policy';
export function readDocument(ownerId: string, actorId: string): string { if (!canReadDocument(ownerId, actorId)) throw new Error('Forbidden'); return 'document'; }
